title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Two cursors and one Enter moved every color swatch and every forced unwrap highlight below the lower cursor one line too far down, one extra line per cursor above it.

highlights.title: Multi Cursor Line Edits
highlights.description: A change event carrying several edits that add or remove lines now repaints the file whole. Organise imports, format on save and replace all send the same shape of event.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Edits in one event arrive in coordinates of the document from before the keystroke, while the document already carries them all. The incremental path counted the shift of the cursor above twice.
Typing with several cursors without changing the line count keeps the fast path, since the two coordinate spaces then agree.
